description: Completed in https://github.com/ergoplatform/ergo/pull/2921: optimized VersionedLDBAVLStorage.serializedVisitedNodes, VersionedLDBAVLStorage.update, and ProverNodeSerializer.toBytes (using pre-sized Array[Byte] + System.arraycopy to avoid Scala 2.12 ArrayBuilder.ofByte.++= boxing overhead), and added StoredNodeBytesSpecification verifying SHA-256 byte-for-byte equivalence against v6.0.11.
